description: Test suite for Discord account resolution and configuration functions, using Vitest. Defines tests for resolveDiscordAccount, createDiscordActionGate, and resolveDiscordMaxLinesPerMessage with various configuration scenarios.

methods.name: resolveDiscordAccount
methods.description: Resolves the Discord account configuration based on provided config and account ID, considering default and override rules.

methods.name: createDiscordActionGate
methods.description: Creates a gate function for Discord actions, returning specific action configuration based on input settings.

methods.name: resolveDiscordMaxLinesPerMessage
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of lines per message for Discord, considering configuration precedence and runtime overrides.
